alt: The inference stack, top to bottom: serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang), continuous batching, the Flash Attention 2 kernel, PagedAttention for the KV cache, quantization from FP8 to INT8 to 4-bit, and the GPU. Numbered tags give the order to apply them: continuous batching first, Flash Attention 2 second, FP8 third, PagedAttention fourth, INT8 or 4-bit last.
caption: Apply the levers in the numbered order. The basics move throughput more than the sophisticated techniques do.
